keywords: food fruit vegetable kitchen organic leftovers peels
preparation: Keep food and other compostable organic material separate from dry recyclable materials.
route: Use the organic or composting collection route available in the user's locality, where provided.
caution: Do not assume that every locality accepts every type of organic material in the same collection stream.
source: General educational guidance based on waste-management principles

keywords: paper cardboard newspaper box carton notebook
preparation: Keep paper and cardboard reasonably clean and dry. Remove obvious non-paper attachments where practical.
route: Use the dry recyclable or paper collection stream where such collection exists.
caution: Local recyclability rules can differ for contaminated or coated paper products.
source: General educational guidance; verify local rules

keywords: plastic bottle wrapper container packet bag packaging
preparation: Keep plastic items separate from organic waste and, where appropriate, empty obvious contents before disposal.
route: Use the recyclable-plastic or designated plastic-waste collection route available locally.
caution: Not every plastic item is accepted by every recycling system.
source: General educational guidance; verify local rules

preparation: Keep glass separate from loose organic waste and handle broken glass carefully.
route: Use the local glass or recyclable collection channel where available.
caution: Broken glass can cause injury. Handle it carefully.

keywords: metal can aluminium tin steel utensil
preparation: Keep metal items separate and reasonably free from food residue where practical.
route: Use the local recyclable-metal collection route where available.
caution: Sharp metal objects can cause injury.

keywords: phone laptop charger keyboard mouse computer electronics circuit
preparation: Keep electronic waste separate from ordinary household waste.
route: Use an appropriate e-waste collection or recycling channel available in the locality.
caution: Do not dismantle electronic equipment yourself just to dispose of it.
source: General e-waste guidance; verify current local collection arrangements

keywords: battery cell rechargeable lithium AA AAA power bank
preparation: Keep used batteries separate from ordinary household waste.
route: Use a suitable battery or e-waste collection channel available locally.
caution: Do not puncture, burn, crush, or dismantle batteries.
source: General safety guidance; verify local collection arrangements

keywords: sanitary pad diaper tissue hygiene waste
preparation: Follow the local designated handling method and keep sanitary waste appropriately wrapped or contained where required.
route: Use the designated sanitary or domestic waste route provided by the local authority or collection service.
caution: Do not place sanitary waste into a recycling stream.
source: General educational guidance; verify local rules

keywords: paint pesticide chemical solvent cleaner oil chemical container
preparation: Keep potentially hazardous chemical material separate from ordinary household waste.
route: Follow the local hazardous-waste or authorized collection instructions.
caution: Do not mix unknown chemicals or pour hazardous substances into drains.
source: General safety guidance; verify local authority instructions

preparation: Do not guess when the material cannot be identified reliably.
route: Ask for additional information or consult the appropriate local waste-management authority.
caution: The system should not invent a disposal instruction when the item is uncertain.
